summary: Americas Gold and Silver Corporation filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated September 17, 2026, announcing high-grade silver-copper drill results from its Cosala Complex in Mexico. The release reports 44 drillholes (55 total) from 1H 2026 infill and step-out drilling at the San Rafael Upper, 120 Upper and 120 Lower deposits, highlighted by hole SR583 intersecting 20.5 meters of 654.7 g/t silver and 1.5% copper, roughly 30 meters outside the 2025 inferred resource boundary. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are stated; this is an ordinary operational exploration update, not a special situation.
